activity.notes: Subcomandante Insurgente Marcos became the internationally visible spokesperson and military subcommander of the EZLN with its public uprising on 1 January 1994. At 02:08 on 25 May 2014 he publicly declared that the Marcos persona ceased to exist and that his voice would no longer speak for the EZLN, thereafter adopting the name Galeano. ATLAS therefore uses 1994–2014 as the closed Marcos public-leadership interval and does not treat him as sovereign ruler of the Zapatista communities.
